suppress.notes: CVE-2022-32511 affects jmespath.rb (JMESPath for Ruby) before 1.6.1, which uses JSON.load where JSON.parse is preferable. NVD scopes it to cpe:2.3:a:jmespath:jmespath:*:*:*:*:*:ruby:*:* -- it does not affect the Python jmespath distribution.

CVE-2026-54133 affects jmespath.php before 2.9.1, where JmesPath\CompilerRuntime can execute attacker-controlled PHP code. NVD scopes it to cpe:2.3:a:jmespath:jmespath:*:*:*:*:*:php:*:* -- it does not affect the Python jmespath distribution.
